desc: Initialize `dp_prev` for `g=0` (dp[0][0]=0, dp[0][i>0]=inf) and set `ans = inf`.
For each group count `g` from 1 to `n`:
Build a convex hull deque of lines `(m, b) = (-C[j], dp_prev[j] - C[j]*k*g)`, maintaining monotonic slopes.
For each `i` from 1 to `n`, query the hull at `x = P[i]` to compute `dp_curr[i] = (P[i] + k*g) * C[i] - min_query`, then add new line for `i` to the deque.
